g.text: Figure 21-1 — the locate automaton M = (S, s0, L, δ, η) for L = { app(lam(M), N) }
δ branches on the head symbol read at the single inspected position L(s); each subject symbol is visited once
A HOLE at the inspected position SUSPENDS the run.
The suspended configuration tree is reflected to a channel:
One state = one inspected position = one head-symbol
decision. No position is ever re-read → SYMBOL-ONCE (O1).
